judgments.note: components.md allows omitting the wrapper without saying how the forms are told apart; the rule is the safe reading. Docs silent.

Re-run: claude plugin validate 2.1.325 reports `mcpServers: Invalid input` for an inline url-without-type entry. mcp.md skip rules name .mcp.json, ~/.claude.json, settings and add-json only, so the docs are silent on a manifest inline map.
SDK types still lack ws, headersHelper and oauth; mcp.md has no full field table. Evidence named is consistent.
mcp.md names the alias only; silent on whether the type is kept.
Docs-vs-docs contradiction (mcp.md unset-variable rule vs plugins/troubleshooting.md "Missing environment variables" for plugin servers) re-read; the plugin page decides for plugins.
mcp.md gives only the two forms; grammar edge cases are silent.
mcp.md lists credential names with "such as"; the helper rule gives patterns plus a fixed list; the set itself is silent.
mcp.md gives the output rule and 10-second limit, not the failure behaviour or case of header names.
mcp.md says "the name of the MCP server"; the scoped name is the safest reading.
Re-run: validate 2.1.325 says the loader refuses only when the plugin declares options; errors.md of the target says the check runs on the template. Target docs kept; evidence true.
mcp.md and errors.md say "characters" only.
Re-run: validate 2.1.325 reports nothing for a plugin server key `workspace`. Docs give the reserved names for "your configuration" only.
Re-run: validate 2.1.325 reports `./x.zip` as `Invalid string: must end with ".json"`. manifest-reference names shapes, not classification.
components.md points to the external MCPB format; silent on the override.
mcp.md: secret only at add time, flags for HTTP and SSE only. Consistent.
errors.md says "less than 15 minutes"; the boundary case is silent.
mcp.md says "about 11,000"; no counting rule in the docs.
mcp.md contrasts the user MCP configuration only with claude.ai connectors; plugin servers are not named.
plugins/loading.md ranks --add-dir lowest for enabledPlugins with only true counting; permissions.md gives no rank for extraKnownMarketplaces. Evidence true.
settings.md says lists combine and is silent on duplicates and order outside managed drop-ins.
Docs fix per-name rules for enabledPlugins and extraKnownMarketplaces only; silent for pluginConfigs, skillOverrides and non-managed nested blocks.
settings-reference types the value Boolean; the SDK type admits more. Silent on non-Boolean values.
settings.md names the kinds without quoting text and is silent on a broken --settings.
settings.md: --settings cannot set Global config keys; no warning text quoted.
settings.md lists only "the ones you are most likely to edit"; managed-settings.md adds forceRemoteSettingsRefresh, requiredMinimumVersion and policyHelper. No closed list in the docs.
managed-settings.md says alphabetical with numeric prefixes, nothing about case or entry order.
The Locks row states the rule without the case where the highest source sets none; ignoring it is the stricter reading.

Re-run on 2.1.325: settings.json `{"agent":5,"model":"x"}` passes validate (warnings only, no dropped-key report); manifest `"settings":"str"` fails with `settings: Invalid input: expected record, received string`. components.md silent on a broken file.
components.md quotes only `overrides setting`.
components.md says "loaded last" without an order.
settings-reference gives the gates for the key without naming the plugin layer.

Re-run: validate 2.1.325 warns that a plugin `agent` setting is deprecated. 2.1.321 docs (components.md "Default settings", settings-reference `agent`) state the key supported; documented behaviour kept, not an E4a case since the warning is past the target.

settings.md: a project or local value "that isn't stricter is ignored", silent when nothing else sets the key; settings-reference crossSessionInbound covers project hold/refuse applying when no trusted source sets one, consistent with the judgment.
